parameters.query: SELECT id, name, kind, url, CASE WHEN kind = 'newsdata' THEN d_cfg('newsdata_api_key', '') END AS api_key FROM sources WHERE active ORDER BY id;
SELECT s.r AS result, save_ingest_images($1) AS images FROM (SELECT ingest_batch($1) AS r OFFSET 0) s;
SELECT name, last_ok_at, last_error, last_counts FROM sources WHERE active ORDER BY last_error NULLS LAST, name;
SELECT feed_alerts() AS bad, d_config_json() AS cfg;
